content_fields.title: Test prevention of path environment attacks (Bash/Shell)
content_fields.description: Add a check that the scripts cannot be redirected through a hostile PATH.
content_fields.finding: There is no PATH hardening in the script to exercise.
content_fields.required_fix:
# app/tests/security/test_ops_scripts.sh
set -euo pipefail

TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
printf '#!/bin/sh\necho HIJACKED\n' > "$TMP/docker"
chmod +x "$TMP/docker"

output="$(PATH="$TMP:$PATH" SDE_DEPLOY_ROLE=operator ./start_app.sh 2>&1 || true)"
case "$output" in
    *HIJACKED*) echo "FAIL: PATH hijack succeeded" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
criteria: A test plants a shadowing binary on PATH and asserts it is not executed.
